headline: Lindsay Clancy 🥺🧠 begs for HELP 🆘 before kids 💔 tragedy
text:
Lindsay Clancy 🥺👩‍⚕️ was BEGGING for HELP 🆘🆘 before the unthinkable happened, her ex-mother-in-law Susan Clancy testified at the murder trial! 💔😭

Lindsay was STRUGGLING 😩💊 with insomnia, losing her appetite, and feeling super anxious and sad after baby Callan was born 🍼😢. She told her fam she was "really sick" and started having scary thoughts about hurting her kids, but she was "begging" for help from doctors and trying everything to get better 🏥💪.

Her mom Paula Musgrove testified that Lindsay was a "very loving, nurturing" mom who ALWAYS wanted to be a mother and have lots of kids 👩‍👧‍👦❤️. But after Callan, she started texting that she was "really sick" and told her family she was having thoughts of harming the children 😰💭.

Lindsay, a nurse herself, kept saying "This isn't me, I've never been like this before" 😭👩‍⚕️. Her family agreed - this wasn't the Lindsay they knew!

Prosecutors say Lindsay made a "calculated decision" to strangle her three kids - Cora 5, Dawson 3, and baby Callan 8 months - with fitness bands in their Massachusetts home 🏠💔. Then she jumped out a second-floor window and is now paralyzed, attending trial in a wheelchair ♿😢.

But the defense says Lindsay was experiencing postpartum psychosis 🧠⚠️ - hallucinations, delusions, and suicidal thoughts every day for a month before the tragedy. She even checked herself into a psych hospital just before the deaths 🏥💊.

The UK NHS says postpartum psychosis is a "serious mental illness" and "medical emergency" - very different from "baby blues" 🆘🍼. Lindsay's family says she was "very much" interested in getting better and seeing doctors, but her mental health spiraled out of control 😭💔.

Three weeks of testimony from dozens of witnesses, and now the defense is presenting their case with personal anecdotes from family members who knew Lindsay as a loving mom who was desperately trying to get help 🆘💪.
